title: 12.10.2026 BZA Agenda Final.pdf
text: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING WORCESTER COUNTY BOARD OF ZONING APPEALS AGENDA THURSDAY December 10, 2026 Pursuant to the provisions of the Worcester County Zoning Ordinance, notice is hereby given that a public hearing will be held in-person before the Board of Zoning Appeals for Worcester County, in the Board Room (Room 1102) on the first floor of the Worcester County Government Center, One West Market Street, Snow Hill, Maryland. Audio and video recording will take place during this public hearing. The public is invited to view this meeting live online at - https://worcestercountymd.swagit.com/live 6:30 p.m. Case No. 26-72, on the lands of Jennifer and Dean DiMattia, requesting a variance to reduce the Chesapeake Bay Critical Area Buffer from 100 feet to 37.79 feet (to encroach 62.21 feet) for a proposed garage in the A-1 Agricultural District, pursuant to Zoning Code §§ ZS 1-116(m), ZS 1-201(b)(5), ZS 1-201(d)(2) and ZS 1-305 and Natural Resources Code §§ NR 3-104(d)(4) and NR 3-111, located at 500 Shore Line Lane, Tax Map 98, Parcel 2, Tax District 1, Worcester County, Maryland. 6:35 p.m. Case No. 26-73 on the application of Mark Spencer Cropper, on the lands of Coastal Square, LLC, requesting a special exception to allow an 8 foot high enclosure around a dumpster in the front yard setback in the C-3 Highway Commercial District, pursuant to Zoning Code §§ ZS 1-116(c)(3), ZS 1305(k)(3) and ZS 1-325 located South of US Route 50 (Ocean Gateway), Tax Map 26, Parcel 474, Lot 3, Tax District 3, Worcester County, Maryland Written public comments may be posted on the County website with names and addresses; phone numbers and email addresses will be redacted. Comments received by noon the Monday prior to the scheduled hearing will be included in the public hearing record. Written comments may be submitted in the following forms: • Via email to BZA@worcestermd.gov Mailed to: Board of Zoning Appeals c/o Savannah Guy 1 West Market Street, Room 1201 Snow Hill, Maryland 21863 Administrative Matters IMPORTANT NOTICE Due to recent email scams by an individual impersonating a County employee alleging that unanticipated fees are owed, please know that Development Review and Permitting (DRP) will never require payment by wire transfer. If you receive such an email or call, contact DRP directly at 410-632-1200, and staff will be glad to assist you.

title: Agenda for Board of Appeals Public Hearing on December 3, 2026
text: CALVERT COUNTY BOARD OF APPEALS Chesapeake Hearing Room 150 Main Street, Prince Frederick, MD 20678 THURSDAY, DECEMBER 3, 2026 AGENDA – Amended* Robert E Carpenter Thomas H Ireland Gerald W Clark Ronald Scott Barbara J Warner The agenda and/or case exhibits may be modified or updated, as needed, up to 24 hours before the hearing. The signed Affidavit(s) and signed Order(s) will be posted within 45 days of the hearing. The public may attend in person, via Teams videoconference, or by dialing +1 872-216-2953 and entering the conference ID: 638176416#. Those who submit written correspondence or verbal testimony shall be considered a party of interest. *Board of Appeals hearings are held on the first Thursday of each month. In the event of an emergency announcement, such as inclement weather, it may be rescheduled for the following Thursday without further publication. For additional information, contact BOA Staff at 410-535-1600, ext. 8552 or BOA@calvertcountymd.gov. I. ROLLCALL Establish a Quorum II. CHAIR'S OPENING STATEMENT – 9:00 a.m. III. The subject property, 2611 Redbud Lane, Owings (Tax Map 10, Parcel 164, Section 3, Lot 54 of The Meadows), is zoned Rural Community District (RCD). 2. The subject property, 3740 Devin Court, Huntingtown (Tax Map 17, Parcel 233, Lot 8 of Oakwood Manor), is zoned Rural Community District (RCD). The subject properties, 13862 HG Trueman Road, Solomons, and 13856 HG Trueman Road, Solomons (Tax Map 44, Parcels 219, 217, & 668, E/S Solomons Island Road), are zoned Town Center District (TC). Email of Concern - Donald McDougall IV. LUNCH BREAK – Tentatively 12:00 - 1:00pm V. RESUME SESSION VI. ADMINISTRATIVE SESSION 1. Updates on previous Board of Appeals cases that have been appealed to a higher court 2. Critical Area Variance Changes/Updates to Documents/Criteria/Findings of Fact Clarification Critical Area Variance Criteria 3. Open Meetings Act Training VII. PUBLIC COMMENT Following the conclusion of all cases and administrative items the Board will accommodate public comment. Speakers will be limited to 2 minutes as individuals or 5 minutes if a designated representative of an organization. VIII. ADJOURN OPEN SESSION IX. This agenda is subject to change and the times listed are approximate. If any items are added for consideration, they will be included on a revised agenda that will be issued prior to the closed session.
